name: Furosemide
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.effect: Higher risk of ototoxicity, especially with impaired kidney function (label).
key_interactions.action: Avoid the combination except in life-threatening situations.

key_interactions.effect: Furosemide reduces lithium clearance; high risk of lithium toxicity (label).
Severe hypotension and worsening kidney function, including kidney failure (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor blood pressure and kidney function; interrupt or reduce the furosemide, ACE inhibitor or ARB dose if needed.
During forced diuresis with cisplatin, use lower furosemide doses with positive fluid balance; monitor kidney function.

key_interactions.effect: Salicylate toxicity at lower doses (shared renal excretion) (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Methotrexate and other drugs cleared by tubular secretion
key_interactions.effect: Each can raise the other's levels and toxicity at high doses (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor drug levels and toxicity; adjust doses if needed.

key_interactions.effect: Higher risk of gouty arthritis (hyperuricemia plus reduced urate excretion) (label).

key_interactions.action: Monitor blood pressure; adjust the other drug if needed.

key_interactions.effect: May blunt the diuretic and antihypertensive effect (label).
key_interactions.action: Check that the expected diuresis and blood-pressure effect are achieved.

key_interactions.effect: Reduces the renal action of furosemide (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor the diuretic effect; adjust the furosemide dose if needed.

key_interactions.effect: Transient rise in free thyroid hormone, then lower total levels (label).
key_interactions.action: Interpret thyroid tests with this in mind.

key_interactions.effect: Flushing, sweating, restlessness, high blood pressure and tachycardia with IV furosemide within 24 hours (label).
